Can I reroute the package to a different address?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Whether you can reroute a package depends on the order status and type.
Before shipping: Address changes may be possible if requested at least 48 hours before the scheduled delivery. You would need to provide the order number, full name, and the new address.
After the order ships: The delivery address usually cannot be changed through us. For parcel or vendor‑shipped items, you’ll need to contact the carrier directly (for example UPS) using the tracking number to request an address correction. Carriers may charge a fee for this service. 
Once the order is already in transit: Address changes are generally not allowed, and any correction must be coordinated with the carrier.
So the best next step is to check the tracking page and contact the carrier listed there to see if they can reroute the package.
